name: Thunderbird Minerals Corp.
summary: Thunderbird Minerals Corp. explores for gold and seeks fresh precious metal and copper discoveries in well-endowed terranes of top-tier North American mining jurisdictions. Its Bullseye property sits in Yukon's Wels District, with Eagle Mountain gold in northern British Columbia and the Argo copper-gold property near Quesnel. Vancouver is its base, and it was formed in November 2022.
